name: type:bug
description: Something that works, or should, behaves wrongly

name: type:prototype
description: A spike or exploration; the output is an answer, not kept code

name: type:design
description: Needs a design decision or spec before any code

name: type:docs
description: Documentation only: README, CLAUDE.md or a spec; no behaviour change

name: size:S
description: Under half a day, one package, no contract change

name: size:M
description: One to two days, or one PR across two packages

name: size:L
description: Several days, or a stack of PRs

name: size:XL
description: Too big to start; split it first

name: agent:build
description: Opt in: the nightly run builds this issue, whatever its size

name: hold
description: Paused by a person: the nightly run neither builds nor pushes it

name: nightly:paused
description: On the Nightly triage issue: the next run does nothing

name: epic:approved
description: The epic's owner approved it: /epic approve may create its sub-issues
